style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the ant works his whole body every beat; coins, banknotes, worker ants and the mosquito fly through the foreground into him; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat; the ant fills half the frame height, never far off
character: the ant: glossy black ant, tired eyes, twitchy antennae; the dung beetle: fat bronze beetle; two worker ants; ONE mosquito
props: ONE gold coin stack; ONE ball of crumpled banknotes; ONE bread loaf; ONE crumb; furry mic bottom right
environment: sunlit sandy anthill yard, grass blades and pebbles right by the lens; the dung beetle and his bread loaf close by, mid-ground

audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, weary but brisk, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ya ta-SHU na se-BYE BOL'-she, chem VYE-shu SAM. a v i-TO-ge hva-TA-yet TOL'-ko na od-NU KROSH-ku
audio.pacing: 0.6-6.2 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.2 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: coin clinks, sand puffs, swooshes, buzz, crunch

timeline.a: the ant already heaves a gold coin stack three times his size on his back; ONE more coin slams onto it, his legs punch into the sand and he bucks back up; sand and grass blades spray across the lens
timeline.c: extreme close, low angle, push in

timeline.a: the ant trots hard on the spot on all six legs, the stack bouncing on every step, jaws open on every word; a crumpled banknote whips across the lens

the ant kicks a loose coin up with a back leg, it flips over his head onto the stack, he slams his body against the swaying stack, jaws open on every word; two worker ants with coins scurry through the foreground
the ant humps and flings the whole stack up over his head, jaws open on every word; coins rain through the foreground, the dung beetle rolls his banknote ball in and coins stick to it
timeline.c: close, tilt up with the coins

timeline.a: the ant stamps on the spot on all six legs, pumping both empty front claws, jaws open on every word; worker ants dump coins onto the beetle ball in the foreground
the ant drops into a goalkeeper crouch, front legs spread; in the foreground the dung beetle snaps ONE crumb off the bread loaf and flicks it to the ant
timeline.c: close, low angle, rack focus beetle to ant

timeline.a: the ant dives, catches the crumb in both front legs, rolls once in the sand, springs up hugging it and stares straight out at us
the ant spins a tiny happy jig on six legs, crumb hugged; the dung beetle rolls his huge banknote ball across the lens
ONE mosquito zips in across the lens and bites off half the crumb; the ant leaps up snapping his jaws at it, lands, antennae drooping
timeline.c: close, whip tilt up then down

timeline.a: the ant gulps the half crumb whole; a worker ant slaps a fresh coin onto his back, the ant buckles, kicks sand across the lens and heaves it up
timeline.c: medium close, low angle, swing up

must_appear: ant already heaving at 0.0, not posing; stack flung 3.2, crumb catch 6.8, mosquito bite 8.3
negative_prompt: held mic, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.2, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, price tags, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, pause inside a line, extra word, mouth shut, duplicate props, floating objects, a hero running at the camera on his feet, frontal stance while talking, a wide shot, a distant hero, a parked camera, a still background, a motionless first or last second, top-down view, a cart, a rail
